title: Food & Nutrition
signal: Food insecurity and malnutrition remain urgent.
need: Child nutrition support, food assistance, and nutrition screening.
responsibleAction: Support child nutrition response through verified actors.
trustEvidence: Official UN and NGO profiles, public reporting, and human review required.
shareableOutput: One-page briefing or campus action note.
caveats: No direct contact with minors or vulnerable people.

title: Health
signal: Health services remain under severe strain.
need: Emergency health services, public-health preparedness, maternal health, and referral awareness.
responsibleAction: Support emergency health services through official and reviewed health actors.
trustEvidence: Organization evidence, official channels, public reporting, and compliance review required.
shareableOutput: Health support briefing with public-health caveats.
caveats: No facility details or operational locations.

title: WASH / Disease Prevention
signal: WASH risks remain connected to water, sanitation, fuel, and disease prevention.
need: Safe water, hygiene promotion, disease-prevention awareness, and referral awareness.
responsibleAction: Support WASH and disease prevention through verified WASH partners.
trustEvidence: Verified WASH partners, public source evidence, and review status before routing.
caveats: This pathway links to official public-health guidance and does not provide medical advice.

title: Education & Children
signal: Education disruption creates immediate and long-term child protection risks.
need: Temporary learning, safeguarding, teacher support, psychosocial support basics, and youth agency.
responsibleAction: Support partner-mediated temporary learning and child protection programs.
trustEvidence: Child-focused work requires safeguarding evidence, partner mediation, and human approval.
shareableOutput: Partner intake checklist or temporary learning briefing.
caveats: No direct unsupervised contact with minors.
All child-related support must be safeguarding-reviewed.

title: Protection, Women, Youth & Social Cohesion
signal: Protection needs are high for women, children, youth, and displaced families.
need: Dignity-centered protection, safeguarding, psychosocial support, youth leadership, and accountable services.
responsibleAction: Support women, youth, and psychosocial protection through reviewed organizations.
trustEvidence: Profiles require evidence review, safeguarding review, and action-routing restrictions.
caveats: No direct contact with vulnerable people.

title: Responsible Giving
signal: People want to help but face many claims, organizations, and urgent appeals online.
need: Source verification, transparency review, official channels, and action-routing discipline.
responsibleAction: Review evidence and use official organization channels only where appropriate.
trustEvidence: Transparency Passport fields show evidence availability without ranking or endorsement.
shareableOutput: Donor checklist or evidence review note.
caveats: We do not rank or endorse organizations.

title: Campus Polarization
signal: Campus conversations can become polarized and emotionally charged.
need: Conflict intelligence, emotional regulation, dialogue facilitation, narrative awareness, and safer learning spaces.
responsibleAction: Create a structured, facilitated learning space with trauma-aware language.
trustEvidence: Public materials need review, caveats, and conflict-sensitive facilitation.
caveats: No manipulation, shame-based messaging, or forced dialogue.

title: Youth Leadership
signal: Long-term recovery requires youth agency, learning, civic capacity, and social cohesion.
need: Youth leadership, safeguarding, civic learning, emotional intelligence, cultural intelligence, and dialogue capacity.
responsibleAction: Support partner-mediated youth leadership and social cohesion pathways.
trustEvidence: Youth-serving work requires safeguarding evidence and human approval.
caveats: No direct unsupervised contact with minors or vulnerable people.

title: Technology Without Harm
signal: Technologists and labs may want to build tools during crisis.
need: Data minimization, privacy, public-data-only design, partner review, and no beneficiary identification.
responsibleAction: Build tools only with public data, safeguards, and partner review before deployment.
trustEvidence: Technology projects require advisor review, data ethics review, and no sensitive operational data.

title: Future Capacity / Long Arc
signal: What we do today should connect to recovery, dignity, wellbeing, and future peace.
need: Time horizons, systems recovery, youth leadership, trust, public health, learning, and peace capacity.
responsibleAction: Choose an action that matters now and can contribute to long-term capacity.
trustEvidence: Long-arc action still requires source evidence, caveats, and local validation.
caveats: Capacity needs are hypotheses, not judgments.
